d:
The backstories of the most interesting, classic or outright nice to look at cards from the Duel Monsters card game of Yu-Gi-Oh! fame.

As usual, sometimes expect either wholesome crossover but also some truely wtf soft-vore or other wtf fetish stuff as bonus non-canon to the story artworks, because why not, it is fun to see how much the AI can be jailbroken until the filters impedes.

Can also be read here (recommended, because of vertical scrolling and full-screen images on mobile):
https://globalcomix.com/c/duel-monsters-backstories
